description: This file defines a stubbed authentication context for a React application, providing no-op implementations of login, logout, and registration functions for a no-auth mode. It includes context creation, a provider component, and a hook for consuming the auth context.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the authentication context to its children, with stubbed methods for login, logout, and registration.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, returning default no-op functions if the context is not available.
